consoleReady.message: Ready. Press Run to start Electron {{version}}.
consoleReady.description: First console line in a new window. {{version}} is the selected Electron version.

started.description: Console line when the fiddle starts. {{version}} is e.g. v43.0.0 or a local build's name; {{name}} is the app name from the fiddle's package.json.

inspector.description: Console line with the Node inspector port of the running fiddle.

exitedCode.description: Console line when the fiddle exits.

exitedSignal.description: Console line when the fiddle is killed by a signal, e.g. SIGTERM.

spawnFailed.description: Console line when Electron can't be started.

runFailed.description: Console line when a run fails for a reason other than a refused check or a failed install, for example a full disk. {{message}} is the system's error.

privacyHelperMissing.message: The privacy helper ({{path}}) is missing or can't run, so fiddles can't start: they would share Electron Fiddle's camera, microphone and other permissions. Reinstall Electron Fiddle.
privacyHelperMissing.description: Console error in a packaged macOS build when the helper that starts fiddles without Electron Fiddle's privacy permissions is missing. {{path}} is where it should be.

downloading.description: Console line before a run downloads its Electron version.

downloadFailed.description: Console line and notice when a download fails.

installingModules.description: Console line before npm or yarn installs the fiddle's modules.

installingModulesNoScripts.message: Installing modules with {{pm}}. Install scripts are off because this fiddle isn't trusted.
installingModulesNoScripts.description: Console line before modules install for an untrusted fiddle.

modulesFailed.description: Console line when the module install fails.

noSocketFirewall.message: Socket Firewall isn't available, so modules install without it.
noSocketFirewall.description: Console warning when the Socket Firewall setting is on but its binary is missing.

pmMissing.message: {{pm}} wasn't found. Install it to use modules: {{url}}
pmMissing.description: Console error when the package manager is missing. {{url}} explains how to install it.

versionUnavailable.message: Electron {{version}} can't run on this computer.
versionUnavailable.description: Console error from the pre-run checks.

versionUnknown.description: Console error from the pre-run checks.

localBuildMissing.message: The local build “{{name}}” is missing its Electron binary.
localBuildMissing.description: Console error when the chosen local build is gone.

esmNeeds28.description: Console error from the pre-run checks: ES module entry points need Electron 28.

envInvalid.message: Skipped environment entries that couldn't be read: {{entries}}
envInvalid.description: Console warning about the environment variables setting.

envBlocked.message: Skipped environment variables that fiddles can't set, because they load code into Electron or change how it starts: {{keys}}
envBlocked.description: Console warning: LD_*, DYLD_*, NODE_OPTIONS and ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE can't be set. {{keys}} is a comma-separated list.

addLocalBuildTitle.message: Choose the folder with your Electron build
addLocalBuildTitle.description: Title of the folder dialog for adding a local build.

addLocalBuildButton.description: Confirm button of the folder dialog for adding a local build.

noBinaryTitle.message: There's no Electron build in this folder
noBinaryTitle.description: Error dialog title when a local build folder has no Electron binary.

noBinaryDetail.description: Error dialog detail with the expected binary.

cannotRemoveActive.message: Electron {{version}} is in use, so it can't be removed.
cannotRemoveActive.description: Error when removing a version a window uses.

making.message: Making installers with Electron Forge in {{path}}…
making.description: Console line when making installers starts.

commandFailed.description: Console error when an npm or yarn command fails.

untrusted.message: This fiddle isn't trusted, so it can't run here.
untrusted.description: Console error when the user declines to trust a fiddle.

scriptsRequired.message: Building needs the install scripts of {{packages}}, but they aren't allowed for this fiddle. Try again and allow install scripts when Electron Fiddle asks.
scriptsRequired.description: Console error when package or make is refused because an untrusted fiddle's modules need install scripts. {{packages}} is a comma-separated list.

bisectStep.description: Console line for each bisect step.

bisectVerdictGood.description: Console line after a bisect step.

bisectVerdictBad.description: Console line after a bisect step.

bisectDone.message: Bisect done: the change is between Electron {{good}} and {{bad}}. {{url}}
bisectDone.description: Console line with the bisect result and the GitHub comparison URL.

bisectVerifyFailed.message: Bisect stopped: Electron {{version}} didn't give the expected result, so the range can't be trusted.
bisectVerifyFailed.description: Console error when the good or bad end fails re-verification.

bisectInvalid.message: Bisect stopped because a run didn't start.
bisectInvalid.description: Console error when an automatic bisect step is invalid.

bisectTooFew.message: Bisect needs at least two versions between the good and bad ones.
bisectTooFew.description: Error when the bisect range is too small.

openCompareMessage.description: Confirmation before opening the bisect comparison in the browser.

openCompareButton.description: Button that opens the comparison in the browser.
